questions.text: According to the text, which of the following statements is true?
options: Scientists were concerned about ocean pollution
There are 11 rare animals being investigated
Bio-accumulation doesn't occur in humans
Cetaceans are alpha predators
Two dolphins found in Florida had the highest liver mercury concentrations
questions.correctAnswer: Scientists were concerned about ocean pollution
questions.explanation: The text states in the first sentence that 'Marine biologists have been sounding the alarm about ocean pollution since the 1950s.'

questions.text: According to the last paragraph, it can be concluded that...
options: Ocean pollution harms sea creatures
Transfer contaminants and bio-accumulation happened in ocean-dwelling animals
Beaked whale's liver had huge amount of arsenic
Whale and dolphins are chosen to be investigated because they are apex predators
Cancer in marine mammal is rare
questions.correctAnswer: Transfer contaminants and bio-accumulation happened in ocean-dwelling animals
questions.explanation: The last paragraph concludes with the discussion on the transfer of contaminants and bio-accumulation happening not just in animals, but also humans.

questions.text: Which of the following is false?
options: The rising average temperature is one of the climate change's effects
Daniel did the first ever study of temperature asymmetries to cover all global lands
The daytime ecology is literally overstudied, leaving the nighttime ecology
The team plotted more than 30 years of temperature, cloud cover, humidity, and precipitation data
The cloud cover has nothing to do with the change in nighttime's temperatures
questions.correctAnswer: The cloud cover has nothing to do with the change in nighttime's temperatures
questions.explanation: The text explicitly states that the change in nighttime temperatures appears to be closely tied to shifts in cloud cover.

questions.text: To put in another word, we can say that this text talks about...
options: There are reduce in the grasshoppers' numbers
One of climate change's repercussions is rising average temperature
Wetter regions got cloudier at daytime and warmer at night
Nowadays climate change is really messed up

questions.correctAnswer: The shift in daily temperature influences how plants and animals cope with climate change
questions.explanation: The passage highlights temperature asymmetries (nighttime temperatures increasing faster than daytime) and how it affects ecosystems.

questions.text: Based on the passage, it can be inferred that a big advantage AlphaFold has over more traditional methods of predicting the shape of a protein is...
options: its ease of use for biologists.
the rate at which it can make predictions.
its ability to always yield fully accurate predictions.
the usefulness of its predictions.
its ability to make predictions without any kind of human intervention.
questions.correctAnswer: the rate at which it can make predictions.
questions.explanation: The text contrasts traditional lab methods taking weeks or months with AlphaFold predicting shapes in a day or two.

questions.text: Which of the following statements is true according to the passage?
options: DeepMind announced that it has predicted every protein in humans.
For a prediction to be useful to researchers, it must be accurate down to the atomic level.
AlphaFold has always been able to estimate how accurate its predictions are.
AlphaFold can produce results that are highly accurate.
It could take months for AlphaFold to predict protein shapes in the lab.
questions.correctAnswer: AlphaFold can produce results that are highly accurate.
questions.explanation: Paragraph 10 mentions AlphaFold predicted shapes for 36% of human proteins with accuracy correct down to individual atoms.
